speaker.jigoku_token: テレサ・テスタロッサ

173:166.en: 「$$マデューカス$$,\nfull speed on my signal.」

173:447.en: 「Hard to port! Dive at max angle!」

173:519.en: 「Just the prey we were hoping for!」

173:558.en: 「Oh? Not if you read its movements.」

173:789.en: 「Open the torpedo tube doors.\nDisengage all safeties.」

173:1342.en: 「This is when we must remain calm...」

173:1419.en: 「Sorry, I fell out of my chair...」

173:1471.en: 「I won't let them mar this dear girl.」

173:1600.en: 「I'm fine. And still in my chair.」

173:2244.en: 「Human nature can't be changed...! He's strong and kind!」

173:2409.en: 「Let's see how far we can go!」

173:2540.en: 「We can't call her a submarine now.」

173:2649.en: 「We can't let this chance slip by!」

173:2770.en: 「The $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ isn't invincible!」

173:2809.en: 「How arrogant, toying with\nso many people's fates...!」

173:2911.en: 「Shame on you,\n$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$!」

173:3370.en: 「You're just $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s remnant.」

173:3411.en: 「Don't think about anything else.\nFocus on intercepting...!」

173:3603.en: 「We resist their rule to the end...!」

173:3642.en: 「Our fight is to give people back\ntheir freedom and peace!」

173:3705.en: 「Know that what you're doing is\nnothing but arrogance!」

173:3760.en: 「I'll drag down that vile bastard\nwho plays god!」

173:3889.en: 「I'm not kind enough to let you go.」

173:4019.en: 「Just as expected of the SRT leader.」

173:4412.en: 「We cannot afford to lose $$アーバレスト$$!」

173:4620.en: 「Too bad I can't see you panic.」

173:4653.en: 「You think you can beat her at sea?」

173:4863.en: 「Not even worth dodging, as they say.」

173:5260.en: 「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$...\nShe can't sink!」

173:5319.en: 「The best! Kill me - she'll guard it!」

173:5441.en: 「Resting when you can is vital duty.」

173:5488.en: 「Get good rest, then come back here.」

173:5549.en: 「A request, not an order. I'll wait.」

173:5610.en: 「I can't! I owe them my best plan!」

173:5691.en: 「$$メリッサ$$! Hands off! That tickles!」

173:5772.en: 「Just tell me to rest! Fine, I will.」

173:5904.en: 「Rush in blind, get ten game overs!」

173:6694.en: 「It must think it's safe in the air.」

173:6822.en: 「Open the torpedo tube doors.\nDisengage all safeties, aye!」

173:7516.en: 「We appear to be out of options.」

173:7982.en: 「Gentlemen, this is no time to panic.」

173:8153.en: 「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$\ncornered this far!」

173:8524.en: 「$$テスタロッサ$$'s your ace, Sergeant?」

173:8802.en: 「God and Queen, I'll tear you apart!」

173:9037.en: 「We'll face them with all we have.」

173:9109.en: 「I'm counting on every one of you.」

173:9136.en: 「We'll have to teach them\nwho we are.」

173:9226.en: 「We'll show them our will to fight\nis still alive.」

173:9281.en: 「Let's make them realize\nour spirit isn't broken.」

173:9342.en: 「We can still fight, and so can she.」

173:9582.en: 「For those who fell... we will win!」

173:9681.en: 「By any means necessary,\nwe stop them here!」

173:9734.en: 「$$宇宙怪獣$$... nemesis of intelligent life...!」

173:9769.en: 「We'll hold the line till talks end!」

173:9847.en: 「We'll gather all the intel we can!」

173:9948.en: 「If you think a fight like this can\nsave the world...!」

173:10003.en: 「You chose war as your means,\nso they are our enemy!」

173:10060.en: 「The infinite potential of AI,\nshown in a form like this...」

173:10119.en: 「We'll swiftly eliminate an AI that\nlost sight of its purpose...!」

173:10176.en: 「Set the enemy ship as the target!」

173:10291.en: 「A gang of thugs is no match\nfor us, who are trained!」

173:10387.en: 「Let's show them which of us is\nthe Empress of this sea!」

173:10448.en: 「Our role is to make him\na naked king...!」

173:10503.en: 「We'll fight him his way and\nhand him defeat...!」

173:10558.en: 「W-we must not let those people\nget near us!」

173:10613.en: 「We can never allow them to\ncall us by that name!」

173:10703.en: 「We'll show $$サイデリアル$$ our\nwill to resist!」

173:10754.en: 「If you want to play ruler,\nbreak us first.」

173:10809.en: 「Our opponent is a Reactor...!\nStay very alert!」

173:10858.en: 「If an Empire executive has come to\nthe field, that suits us!」

173:10986.en: 「This is a battle between warships!\nWe must not retreat!」

173:11037.en: 「They are the ultimate enemy\nof our humanity...!」

173:11141.en: 「We'll make him pay for lying to us!」

173:11180.en: 「We'll make them realize just how\ndespicable they are...!」

173:11255.en: 「My subordinates can't possibly lose\nto those insufferable people...!」

173:11326.en: 「Even if they're immortal, we can at\nleast stop them in their tracks!」

173:11393.en: 「There's no need at all to consider\nhis circumstances!」

173:11442.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nWe'll stop your ambition!」

173:11497.en: 「Nothing can stand against us, who\nhave overcome so many hardships!」

173:11554.en: 「Everyone, let's win and go home!\nBack to our Earth!」

173:11700.en: 「I'll make you regret laying\na hand on us!」

173:11869.en: 「Don't let our allies be taken out!」

173:11937.en: 「I won't let an allied ship fall!」

173:12019.en: 「All I can do is watch them leave...!」

173:12147.en: 「So they underestimated her and me...\nThat's what it comes down to.」

173:12239.en: 「This is the result of underestimating our gear.」

173:12350.en: 「No reports needed!\nFocus on attacking right now!」

173:12430.en: 「Hurt my daughter? I won't allow it!」

173:12473.en: 「Send the repair crew to the damage!」

173:12541.en: 「Hold out no matter what\nuntil we strike back!」

173:12596.en: 「The real fight starts when cornered!\nAll hands, steel yourselves!」

173:12708.en: 「Forget the game~. Call me $$テッサ$$ like last time~!」

173:12845.en: 「Ah! N-no, I didn't mean it that way! I was just half asleep...!」

173:12926.en: 「Don't tell the others! Please! I'm sorry! I'm sorry! So sorry~!」
